manifest.name: dsh-conversation-queue
manifest.description: Cap how many DeepSeek Harness conversations run at once (FIFO queue for the rest), plus a memory/commit/disk status strip in the web UI.

bundle.text:
# dsh-conversation-queue —— 对话并发闸门
#
# 这一层只插入一条 loader 入口，真正的实现在 index.js 里。
# 想改参数有两个办法（二选一，推荐第一种）：
#
#   1) 直接在下面这份 config 里改数值，保存（没生效就重启一次 DSH）；
#   2) 在 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml 里用同一个 id 覆盖，
#      建议把需要的字段写全；没写的字段由 index.js 里的默认值兜底。
#
# 例：只把并发数改成 3
#
#   - id: conversation-queue
#     config:
#       maxConcurrent: 3
#
- insert:
    - id: conversation-queue
      name: 'dsh-conversation-queue'
      config:
        # 总开关：false = 完全不限制（等价于没装本插件）
        enabled: true

        # 同时允许“正在运行”的对话数量。
        # 32G 内存建议 2；内存比较紧张就用 1；确认够用再往上加。
        maxConcurrent: 2

        # 子代理（subagent / 后台任务）是否也参与排队。
        # 必须保持 false：子代理由父对话派生，若它也排队会出现
        # “父对话等子代理、子代理等槽位”的死锁。
        queueSubagents: false

        # 运行状态写到哪里，方便随时查看谁在跑、谁在排队。
        # 留空 = $DSH_HOME/conversation-queue.json（一般是
        # C:\Users\<你>\.dsh\conversation-queue.json）
        statusFile: ''

        # 是否在 DSH 日志里记录每次放行 / 排队。
        logAdmissions: true

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md)

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) 用的并发闸门：**限制同时运行的对话数量**，超出的对话先来后到排队，等前面的回合结束后自动放行；顺手在界面底部挂一条内存 / 提交内存 / 磁盘状态条。

为 32G 内存这类“两个对话一起跑就可能被系统 kill”的机器设计。不再让第 3、第 4 个对话同时发请求，而是让它们静默排队——排队时既不调模型、也不组装上下文，几乎不占内存。

- **对话级并发限制**：到上限的对话停在“发请求之前”，前面的回合结束后按 FIFO 自动放行。
- **底部状态条**（`shell.bottom`）：内存、提交内存、每块固定盘剩余、运行中 / 排队数、当前上限。
- **悬浮解释**：鼠标停在盘符上，能看到它是什么盘（系统盘 / 数据盘）、卷标、文件系统、容量、已用、剩余，以及“为什么系统盘空间紧张会连带杀进程”的说明；停在“对话”上能看到正在跑 / 排队的每一个会话标题和已跑 / 已等时长。
- **设置页**：Plugins → **资源与并发**，同一份数据摊开成表格，并可直接 `−` / `+` 调整上限。
- **运行期调参**：改一个 JSON 文件 1.5 秒内生效，不用改 YAML、不用重启。
- **仅限制根对话**：子代理 / 后台任务不排队（否则父对话等子代理、子代理等槽位会死锁）。

readme.section: 从 GitHub 直接安装（推荐，不需要发 npm）
readme.text:
```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add github:zhengkaixing/dsh-conversation-queue
```

装完重启一次 DSH（新增的浏览器端 bundle 与 HTTP 路由都是启动时挂载的）。

GitHub 拉不动的网络可以走 Gitee 镜像（同一份代码、同样的历史）：

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add https://gitee.com/zhengkaixing/dsh-conversation-queue.git
```

> 插件市场只认 GitHub 仓库地址，Gitee 镜像只是给装不上的网络用的，不参与上架。

在 DSH 的插件市场里搜 `dsh-conversation-queue` 点安装即可——市场条目指向这个 GitHub 仓库，效果和上面的 `github:` 命令完全一样。市场列表由 [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) 维护，每次打开时实时拉取。

> 没有发布 npm 包，别用 `dsh plugin add dsh-conversation-queue`（会去 registry 找同名包）。

```powershell
& '<DSH 安装目录>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add 'link:C:/path/to/dsh-conversation-queue'
```

`dsh plugin add` 会把这个包写进 profile 的 `package.json`、追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles` 并跑一次 pnpm。
改完插件代码需要重启 DSH 才会生效（HMR 只重载配置，不重载插件代码）。

```
内存 60% ▓▓▓░░   提交 89% ▓▓▓▓▓   C: 剩 24.0G   D: 剩 89.4G   E: 剩 14.0G        对话 2 / 3 · 排队 1   −  +
```

- 每 3 秒轮询一次 `GET /dsh-resource/status`，同源、不额外开端口。
- `≥80%` 显示琥珀色，`≥88%` 显示红色。“提交内存”是最该盯的指标：它把页面文件算在内，接近上限时 Windows 会直接杀进程。
- 点 `−` / `+` 立刻改并发上限（写 settings，1.5 秒内生效）。

| 悬浮在盘符上 | 悬浮在“对话”上 |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |
Sidebar → **Plugins** → **资源与并发**：内存 / 磁盘 / 对话并发三段，带表格和 `−` `+`。

配置写在插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: conversation-queue
      name: 'dsh-conversation-queue'
      config:

也可以在 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 里用同一个 id 覆盖（建议把需要的字段写全）：

```yaml
- id: conversation-queue
  config:
    maxConcurrent: 3
```

readme.section: 运行期调整上限（不用重启）
readme.text:
```json
// %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\conversation-queue.settings.json
{ "maxConcurrent": 3, "source": "dsh-ui" }
```

- 可写字段只有 `maxConcurrent`（1~8 的整数）和 `enabled`；没写的字段沿用配置默认值，文件删掉或清空也回到默认值。
- 非法 JSON / `maxConcurrent: 0` 会被忽略并保持当前上限（避免手滑把上限打回 1 或半写入导致乱跳）。
- 三个入口：底部状态条的 `−` `+`、设置页的 `−` `+`、直接编辑这个文件。

| 方法 | 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-resource/status` | `{ ok, time, platform, memory, disks, gate }` |
| POST | `/dsh-resource/limit` | body `{ "maxConcurrent": 3 }`，可选 `{ "enabled": false }`；非法值 400 |

`memory` = `{ totalBytes, availBytes, usedBytes, usedPercent, commitLimitBytes, commitUsedBytes, commitPercent, load, sampler }`；
`disks[]` = `{ name, label, fileSystem, system, totalBytes, freeBytes, usedBytes, usedPercent }`；
`gate` = `{ enabled, maxConcurrent, running, waiting, active: [{ id, title, turn, runningMs }], queue: [{ id, title, position, waitingMs }] }`。

两个接口都经由宿主自己的 HTTP 服务，沿用它的鉴权（同源可用）。
`memory.sampler` 是 `ok` / `starting` / `error: …`：提交内存靠一个常驻 PowerShell 采样进程提供（`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE` 下 Node 拿不到 `process.getSystemMemoryInfo`），启动后 1~2 秒才有值。

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\conversation-queue.json"
```

```json
{
  "running": 2,
  "waiting": 1,
  "maxConcurrent": 2,

- `maxConcurrent` / `enabled` 是**当前生效值**，`configured` 是 YAML 默认值。
- `lastEvent` 变成 `unloaded` 说明插件已卸载或重载失败。
- `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\conversation-queue.boot.log` 记录插件是否被加载（只有 `import` 没有 `apply-ok` 就是加载失败，会带 `apply-failed` 和堆栈）。
- 宿主日志里搜 `conversation-queue:` 能看到每次放行 / 释放 / 排队。

- 排队中的对话在界面上仍显示“运行中”（回合已经开始，只是卡在发请求之前）；状态条和设置页会如实显示“排队”。
- 排队中停止 / 关闭对话会立刻退出队列；正在运行的对话被关闭时槽位立即转给下一位。
- 插件卸载时所有排队者被拒绝/放行，不会留下永远等不到的对话。
- 上限的调整范围是 1~8；再大的值对个人机器没有意义。

```powershell
node test.mjs                        # 13 项单元检查
node ..\..\_scratch\dsh-queue\rig\integration.mjs   # 11 项（真实 cordis 4.0.5 派发）
node ..\..\_scratch\dsh-queue\rig\settings.mjs      # 10 项（运行期改上限）
node ..\..\_scratch\dsh-queue\rig\routes.mjs        # 36 项（HTTP 接口 / 晚就绪注册 / 卸载回收）

`rig` 里用 `react` / `jsdom` 以及从 `app.asar` 抽出来的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`、`@deepseek-ai/cosmokit`（`file:` 依赖）。

[中文](README.md)

A concurrency gate for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai): **cap how many conversations may run at once**, let the rest wait in FIFO order until an earlier turn finishes, and show a memory / commit / disk status strip at the bottom of the web UI.

Built for 32 GB machines where two concurrent conversations are enough to get the host killed by Windows. Instead of running conversation #3 and #4 at the same time, they wait silently — no model call, no context assembly, almost no memory.

- **Conversation-level concurrency limit** — a conversation beyond the cap parks right before its request is sent and is released in FIFO order when an earlier turn ends.
- **Bottom strip** (`shell.bottom`): physical memory, commit memory, free space per fixed drive, running / queued counts, current limit.
- **Hover details**: on a drive letter, what the drive is (system / data), its volume label, file system, capacity, used and free space, plus why a tight system drive makes OOM kills more likely; on the conversation counter, every running and queued session with its title and elapsed / waiting time.
- **Settings page**: Plugins → **资源与并发**, the same data laid out as tables, with `−` / `+` to change the limit.
- **Runtime tuning**: edit one JSON file, effective within 1.5 s — no YAML edit, no restart.
- **Root conversations only**: subagents / background jobs are never queued (otherwise a parent waits for its child while the child waits for a slot — deadlock).

From GitHub (no npm publish needed):

```powershell
& '<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add github:zhengkaixing/dsh-conversation-queue
```

Restart DSH once afterwards: the client bundle and HTTP routes are mounted at startup.

Networks where GitHub is unreachable can use the Gitee mirror (same code, same history):

```powershell
& '<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add https://gitee.com/zhengkaixing/dsh-conversation-queue.git
```

> The plugin market only accepts GitHub repositories; the Gitee mirror exists for unreachable networks and is not a listing.

From the plugin market:

Open the DSH plugin market, search for `dsh-conversation-queue` and hit install — the listing points at this GitHub repository, so it is equivalent to the `github:` command above. The market index is maintained by [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) and fetched live.

> There is no npm package, so `dsh plugin add dsh-conversation-queue` will fail.

Local development:

```powershell
& '<DSH install dir>\resources\runtime\cli\bin\dsh.cmd' plugin --profile web add 'link:C:/path/to/dsh-conversation-queue'
```

`dsh plugin add` writes the package into the profile `package.json`, appends it to `dsh.profile.bundles` and runs pnpm. Plugin code changes require a restart (HMR reloads configuration only).

```
内存 60% ▓▓▓░░   提交 89% ▓▓▓▓▓   C: 剩 24.0G   D: 剩 89.4G   E: 剩 14.0G        对话 2 / 3 · 排队 1   −  +
```

- Polls `GET /dsh-resource/status` every 3 s; same origin, no extra port.
- `≥80%` turns amber, `≥88%` turns red. **Commit memory** is the metric to watch: it includes the page file, and Windows kills processes when it approaches the limit.
- `−` / `+` change the cap immediately (writes the settings file, effective within 1.5 s).

| Hover a drive | Hover the conversation counter |
| --- | --- |
|  |  |
Sidebar → **Plugins** → **资源与并发**: memory, disks and conversation concurrency, with `−` `+`.

      name: 'dsh-conversation-queue'

Override in `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` with the same id if you prefer:

```yaml
- id: conversation-queue
  config:
    maxConcurrent: 3
```

```json
// %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\conversation-queue.settings.json
{ "maxConcurrent": 3, "source": "dsh-ui" }
```

- Writable fields: `maxConcurrent` (integer 1–8) and `enabled`. Omitted fields fall back to the YAML config; deleting or emptying the file does the same.
- Invalid JSON or `maxConcurrent: 0` is ignored, keeping the current limit.
- Three entry points: the strip buttons, the settings page buttons, or this file.

| Method | Path | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/dsh-resource/status` | `{ ok, time, platform, memory, disks, gate }` |
| POST | `/dsh-resource/limit` | body `{ "maxConcurrent": 3 }`, optional `{ "enabled": false }`; 400 on invalid input |

Both routes go through the host's own HTTP server and inherit its auth (same-origin only).
`memory.sampler` is `ok` / `starting` / `error: …`: commit memory comes from a long-lived PowerShell sampler (Node has no `process.getSystemMemoryInfo` under `ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE`), so it needs 1–2 s after startup.

- `maxConcurrent` / `enabled` are the **effective** values; `configured` holds the YAML defaults.
- `lastEvent: "unloaded"` means the plugin was unloaded or failed to reload.
- `$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\conversation-queue.boot.log` records whether the plugin loaded (`import` without `apply-ok` means load failure, with `apply-failed` and a stack).
- Search the host log for `conversation-queue:` to see every admission / release / queue decision.

- A queued conversation still looks "running" in the UI (its turn started, it just hasn't sent a request); the strip and the settings page show the real queued state.
- Stopping / closing a queued conversation drops it from the queue immediately; closing a running one hands the slot to the next waiter at once.
- Unloading the plugin rejects or releases every waiter; no conversation is left waiting forever.
- The limit is constrained to 1–8.
